title: Bishop Museum Main Building
scope: The standing Romanesque Revival main exhibition building of the Bishop Museum in Honolulu, including the original entrance tower and adjoining Hawaiian and Pacific halls.
limitations: The model represents the connected main exhibition halls and the formal entrance. Roof and floor heights are estimated from the historic exterior documentation and the native plan.
The campus’s detached buildings, modern courtyard additions, exhibit interiors and fine entrance ornament are outside scope.
